index.title: Practice
index.subtitle: Short exercises to anchor concepts in practice. Each game targets a specific trader skill.
index.bottomTip: You can also keep going through the lessons in parallel.

buy-sell-no-trade.title: BUY / SELL / NO TRADE
buy-sell-no-trade.description: 12 scenarios to analyze. Mini chart, context, news. You make your call and the system rates your read, your discipline and your trap detection.

place-stop.title: Place your Stop
place-stop.description: Which stop will survive? 10 setups, 3 stop losses offered each time (A / B / C). You pick the most logical one, structure, liquidity, RR. The market reveals what happens next.

find-the-mistake.title: Find the Mistake
find-the-mistake.description: 10 setups with a hidden mistake. You spot the main error among 4 choices. Retail psychology, discipline, liquidity, RR, learn to see the classic traps.

build-the-trade.title: Build the Trade
build-the-trade.description: Build a complete setup: entry, stop, take profit. 8 scenarios, the market then reveals the outcome. RR, drawdown, verdict. The most strategic game.

risk.title: Risk Calculator
risk.description: Quick calculation questions: position size, R/R ratio, amount risked. 30 seconds per question.

zone.title: Bounce or Break?
zone.description: Price reaches a key zone. You call it: bounce or break? Real historical data, 10 rounds.

rr.title: R/R Builder
rr.description: A trade is presented to you with an entry and a stop. You place the target to reach the requested R/R ratio.

structure.title: Read the Structure
structure.description: A chart appears. You identify the last BOS, the CHoCH, and the next zone of interest. 8 rounds.

sizing.title: Position Sizing
sizing.description: Capital, risk in %, stop in pips, calculate the right lot size in under 20 seconds. 10 questions.
